# Echohearts path-specific Copilot instructions

Repository role: **LEGACY_GAME_SUPPORT**

Legacy/prototype game support only. Salvage useful work into the owning canonical/runtime repository instead of creating a competing implementation.

- Follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Inspect actual code/tests before replacing anything.
- Search the seven Echohearts repositories before duplicating a system.
- Preserve Rebearth canon, Eco-Kin taxonomy, 125-ID Permanent Dex, Vibrance/Density/Harmony/Purity, Anima-Link, Huma-Link, and A.E.G.I.S.
- Keep executable gameplay in the BUILD repository unless this repository explicitly owns that runtime code.
- Fix root causes with focused patches and add/update validation.
- Do not copy protected franchise code, assets, names, or story identity.
- Do not claim VERIFIED without relevant evidence.
